title: Marin Mentions monitors that are not organizations
notes: Each entry is a monitor id in marin-mentions/config/monitors.yaml that is deliberately not an organization, with the reason.
A monitor in the Departments, Divisions or Board & Courts group must either carry a local:marin-mentions-monitor-id on an organization in output/organizations.jsonld or be listed here.
